note: Changes flag_dependency_properties and _v1_properties to return list[FlagProperty], folding the generator helper into one list comprehension and dropping the non-generator comment.
Removes the duplicate TextChoices classes and derives serializer choices from the Literal via get_args; the literal is kept rather than removed, but dual maintenance ends.
returnVariable selector now prefers the resolved name from collectNotebookDataframeNodes(content); still computed per insight logic, no shared memoized selector in notebookLogic.
Only removes the legendInteractive prop from the chart in this file; the inline summary card is not folded into RequestUsageSummaryCard.
Replaces the hand-rolled loop in parseProjectFlag with node:util parseArgs (strict, multiple string option), keeping the repeat-count and positive-integer checks.
Routes the description-only branch through listOrCount so it collapses to a count past the limit, and adds a test with four description changes.
_visible_task_queryset uses filter_queryset_by_access_level; edit/restore/access checks use check_access_level_for_object; assignee gets an object-level editor grant on assignment.
Adds a committing() context manager on the resumable source manager and wraps save_state in it, replacing the explicit commit call.
Drops the dangerously_get_permissions override and CustomerTaskPermission; assignee access now written as object-level AccessControl rows via set_object_access_control.
Adds _required_backfill_stamps helper (dict keyed by backfill kind) used by both is_flag_compatible and realtime_ready_at, removing the duplicated mapping and dead else.
Adds unique (id, dataset, team) constraints and composite foreign keys tying dataset item version's dataset_id to its item and revision, then validates them.
Refactors evaluation API calls into patchEvaluation/listAllEvaluations and adds restore action, but deletion still uses a hand-rolled lemonToast with undo, not deleteWithUndo.
Builds _FIX_WRITERS_BY_CACHE_TYPE from get_args(CacheType) plus flag definitions, with flags as the single multi-writer special case.
Moves the tooltip text onto the LemonButton tooltip prop and removes the separate Tooltip/IconInfo element.
Adds _checked_connect_host helper used by _pinned_ssh_host, pinned_connect_host and _check_direct_host, with a uniform error fallback.
Splits into create and update serializers with non-null required cimd_url, read serializer marks it read-only, get_serializer_class picks by action; adds PATCH binding for legacy tokens.
Adds an event restriction service handle and wait_for_restrictions_loaded helper to the test server; next_message helpers are not deduplicated.
Defines READINESS_CHUNKS Q in backfill models and uses it in finalize, inventory, realtime_state and the parity oracle, which now filters readiness chunks.
Extracts the nested ternary into a getScheduleDisabledReason function with early returns and passes its result to disabledReason.
Gives --team-id nargs='+', deletes --team-ids and its comma parsing and guards, and resolves teams into a TeamSelection.
